apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The 'مسار الاعتماد' heading is a bespoke Text with copyWith styling instead of reusing the shared MobileSectionHeader widget.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Replace the raw Text (lines 104-109) with const MobileSectionHeader(title: 'مسار الاعتماد') so section headers render consistently across pages.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The _ErrorState is a plain centered text plus button with no error/brand icon, inconsistent with a polished error presentation.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Add an Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error) above the message (with spacing) so the error state has a clear visual anchor consistent with other states.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The empty approval-steps state (lines 111-117) is a bespoke plain-text Card with no icon or muted styling, unlike a polished empty state.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Style the empty message with colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant and add a small leading icon (e.g. Icons.route_outlined) to match empty-state treatment used elsewhere.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The step CircleAvatar uses default theme colors while the step's status color is ignored, so the order badge gives no status cue.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Tint the CircleAvatar background/foreground per step.status using the shared status color mapping, or set scheme.primaryContainer/onPrimaryContainer explicitly for intent clarity.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: Inter-card vertical spacing is inconsistent: 12 between top cards (lines 97,103) but 16 for action buttons (lines 121,132) and 8 for the section header (line 110).
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Standardize the vertical gaps between stacked cards/sections to a single spacing token (e.g. 12) so the detail list has consistent rhythm.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The cancel/decide dialog confirm buttons silently no-op when the reason is too short (lines 177, 232), giving the user no feedback about why nothing happened.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Show an inline helperText/error on the TextField when the minimum length is not met instead of an unexplained non-response on confirm.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The _RequestCard InkWell uses borderRadius 12, which does not match the design-system Card radius of 20, so the tap ripple is clipped to the wrong corners.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Change BorderRadius.circular(12) to BorderRadius.circular(20) to match the theme Card radius (peer cards like MobileFilterBar/MetricCard rely on the shared Card shape).

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The section titles 'أرصدة الإجازات' and 'طلباتي/طلبات الفريق' are bespoke Text widgets with copyWith(fontWeight: w900) instead of the shared MobileSectionHeader used by every other mobile page.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Replace the two ad-hoc Text section headers (lines 74-79 and 131-136) with MobileSectionHeader(title: ...) for consistent typography and spacing across pages.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The request card hardcodes fontSize values (17 on line 577, 12 on lines 596 and 602, plus 11 not applicable) instead of reading from Theme text styles.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme (e.g. titleMedium for the title, bodySmall/labelSmall for the route/date row) instead of literal fontSize to stay on the type scale.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The error state text is not styled with the error color and lacks the brand/section framing used elsewhere, so it reads as plain body text.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Style the error message with Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error (or wrap in a consistent empty/error block) so it visually signals a failure like other pages.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: In the empty state the search_off icon (line 167) is left-aligned while only the text is wrapped in Center, so the icon and label are misaligned.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Wrap the Icon in Center as well (const Center(child: Icon(Icons.search_off_rounded, size: 48))) so the icon and message are both centered; consider giving it colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The loading-state ListView, SizedBox, Center and CircularProgressIndicator are not marked const, unlike the const-heavy style used throughout the file.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Add const to the loading ListView children (const SizedBox(height: 260), const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())) for consistency and minor perf.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: Request status uses a bespoke Chip with a local _status() switch instead of the shared MobileStatusPill, so it lacks the color-coded status palette used everywhere else.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Replace `Chip(label: Text(_status(item.status)))` with `MobileStatusPill(item.status)` and remove the local `_status` map, giving consistent color-coded pills.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The top summary uses a bespoke three-column metric Row with a private _metric() helper instead of the shared MetricCard/MetricGrid, breaking the standard metric styling.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Replace the Card+Row+_metric block with MetricGrid(cards: [('الخدمات','${data.catalog.length}',Icons.design_services_outlined),('طلباتي','${data.requests.length}',Icons.list_alt_outlined),('مفتوحة','$openCount',Icons.pending_actions_outlined)]) and delete the private _metric helper.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The requests list has no search or filter affordance despite MobileFilterBar being the standard, so users cannot search/filter requests or see a result count.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Add a MobileFilterBar above the list (search by title/serviceName/number plus status choice chips) wired to local filter state, with resultLabel showing the count and onClear resetting it, matching other list pages.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The error state is a bare centered Text with no icon, brand header, or retry action, inconsistent with the app's richer error presentation.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Wrap the error in a Card/centered column with an error icon (colorScheme.error), the message, and a retry TextButton that calls ref.invalidate(myServicePortalProvider).

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The empty-requests state is a plain centered Text with no icon, brand mark, or call-to-action, unlike the design system's fuller empty states.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Give the empty state an illustrative icon (Icons.support_agent_outlined) and a call-to-action button ('طلب خدمة') so it matches other empty headers in the app.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The AppBar shows only a text title with no BrandLogoMark, unlike app bars/headers elsewhere that carry the association brand mark.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Add a leading BrandLogoMark (assets/brand/association-logo-*.png) to the AppBar for brand consistency with other screens.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The request ListTile is non-interactive (no onTap) so tapping a request does nothing, and the leading icon has no semantic label.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: If a detail view exists, add an onTap to the ListTile; otherwise wrap the leading Icon in a Semantics label and confirm the tile is intentionally read-only.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The loading state uses a hardcoded SizedBox height of 220 to fake vertical centering, giving inconsistent placement versus other pages.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Use a shared loading placeholder (e.g. Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 120), child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()))) instead of a magic 220px SizedBox, matching other pages.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: _PriorityPill is a bespoke pill using raw Material colors (Colors.red/orange/blueGrey/blue) instead of the shared MobileStatusPill / status palette, so urgent/high tasks render in a different red-orange than the rest of the app (0xFFDC3D4B / 0xFFD98508).
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Reuse MobileStatusPill(item.priority) (which already handles 'urgent'/'high') or, for the priority-only labels, map to the same status palette hex constants (0xFFDC3D4B urgent, 0xFFD98508 high/medium, onSurfaceVariant low) rather than Colors.red/orange/blueGrey/blue.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: _SourcePill hardcodes Colors.teal for background and text, a color that is not part of the theme colorScheme nor the intentional shared status palette.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Use a theme color (e.g. scheme.secondary or scheme.tertiary with .withValues(alpha:.12) fill) or reuse MobileStatusPill styling so the Onboarding tag matches the design system instead of raw Colors.teal.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The empty state is bespoke and visually inconsistent: the Icon at line 37 is not wrapped in Center (unlike the text) so it left/right-aligns under RTL, and it lacks color/typography styling and any BrandLogo header used elsewhere for empty states.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Wrap the icon in Center, tint it with scheme.onSurfaceVariant, style the message with textTheme.bodyMedium and onSurfaceVariant, and consider a BrandLogoMark above the icon to match the app's empty-state pattern.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The error state has no icon, no brand mark, and the retry OutlinedButton/text are not centered, making it inconsistent with the app's other error states.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Center the content, add an error icon (Icons.error_outline tinted scheme.error) and style the message with onSurfaceVariant, matching the empty/error visual treatment used on other mobile pages.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: _Meta renders both the icon (line 221) and text (line 223) in the default full-strength onSurface color, whereas metadata rows elsewhere use the muted onSurfaceVariant.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Pass color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant to both the Icon and the Text so the due-date/created-by metadata reads as secondary text.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: The status SegmentedButton is the card's only interactive control and, when item.status == 'cancelled', it is silently disabled with no explanation, and it has no Semantics label describing it as the task status control.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: When disabled show a MobileStatusPill('cancelled') / short 'ملغاة' hint instead of a mute disabled control, and wrap the SegmentedButton in a Semantics(label: 'حالة المهمة') for screen readers.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: List item spacing (SizedBox height 10) and list padding (16) are fine, but the 'متأخرة' overdue indicator at line 74 is plain bold text rather than a pill, inconsistent with the pill-based status vocabulary used across the page and app.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Render the overdue flag as a small pill (e.g. MobileStatusPill-style container with scheme.error) to match _PriorityPill/_SourcePill and the shared status pill styling.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: _AttendancePill is a bespoke status-pill reimplementation that duplicates the shared MobileStatusPill widget (same rounded 12%-alpha container, 11px w900 label) instead of reusing it.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Extend the shared MobileStatusPill (add present/late/on_leave/absent/unregistered cases to its switch) and render MobileStatusPill(item.attendanceStatus ?? '') at line 124, deleting the local _AttendancePill class.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: Attendance colors use raw Material palette (Colors.green/orange/blue/red/grey) rather than the app's curated shared status hex palette used by MobileStatusPill (e.g. 0xFF0F9F6E green, 0xFFD98508 amber, 0xFFDC3D4B red).
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Replace Colors.green/orange/blue/red with the shared status palette constants (const Color(0xFF0F9F6E)/(0xFFD98508)/(0xFF008CB3)/(0xFFDC3D4B)) and use scheme.onSurfaceVariant for the unregistered/grey case, matching MobileStatusPill.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: Error state is bare centered text with no icon, muted color, or retry affordance, inconsistent with the app's polished empty/error patterns.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Add a muted error layout (e.g. Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, color: colorScheme.error) + message styled with onSurfaceVariant + a TextButton 'إعادة المحاولة' calling ref.invalidate(mobileTeamProvider)).

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: _metric uses hardcoded TextStyle(fontSize: 18/11) with no theme text style or colorScheme, so the label lacks the standard muted onSurfaceVariant treatment used elsewhere (e.g. MetricCard).
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium (value) and labelMedium.copyWith(color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant) (label) instead of hardcoded fontSize styles.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: Empty-state icon uses size 54 while every sibling page (kpi/requests: 48, executive_people: 42) uses a smaller size, making this page's empty icon an outlier.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Change size: 54 to size: 48 to match the mobile_kpi_page / mobile_requests_page empty-state convention.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: Empty-state icon has no color so it renders at full onSurface opacity instead of the muted tone appropriate for a placeholder.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Add color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant to the search_off_rounded Icon.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.summary: CircleAvatar initial uses item.name.substring(0,1) which throws on an empty name and gives no accessible label/tooltip for the avatar.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/mobile_.fix: Guard the substring (item.name.isEmpty ? '?' : item.name.characters.first) and wrap the leading avatar in a Semantics label of item.name.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/workspa.summary: The 'more' bottom sheet omits showDragHandle: true while the sibling _showProfile sheet (line 408) enables it, so the two modal sheets look inconsistent.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/workspa.fix: Add showDragHandle: true to the showModalBottomSheet call at line 310 to match _showProfile, and remove the manual top padding of 0 so the drag handle spacing is consistent.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/workspa.summary: The 'more' grid tile label uses a bare const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) with no color from the color scheme, unlike the rest of the file which reads colors from Theme.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/workspa.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) or set color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface so the label follows theme/dark-mode colors.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/workspa.summary: The 'more' grid tiles use a bespoke Ink/BoxDecoration card with borderRadius 18, diverging from the design-system card radius of 20.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/workspa.fix: Use borderRadius 20 (matching the app_theme card radius token) for both the InkWell (line 338) and the Ink decoration (line 351) so the tiles align with the design-system card radius.

apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/workspa.summary: The notifications provider's loading and error states are silently coerced to an unread count of 0, so a failed fetch is indistinguishable from having zero unread items.
apps/mobile_flutter/lib/features/workspa.fix: Acceptable for a passive badge, but consider distinguishing error state; silently mapping loading/error to 0 unread hides fetch failures.
